summary: This module handles email popup documents, allowing for searching and deleting email data based on an identifier.
purpose: To provide functionalities for managing email attachments or linked documents within popups.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the email popup document.

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: Name of the file associated with the email popup.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Path to the file associated with the email popup.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Indicates if the document is checked or selected.
